steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: We have a signal, Amiya!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Casters! Hold the shield with me!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everyone else, get to the corner!
The Sarkaz casters raise their staves together.
Monsters made of blood rush up from underground. The entire street opens its gaping maw beneath the soldiers.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Nngh—!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There's too many of them!
Black lines cut through the flesh of the monsters, but even more rise again from the fallen, gnawing away at the Arts forming a defensive barrier.
The fighters run for their lives, but the stench from the predators' jaws is never far behind.
Finally, they make it into another alley, and find themselves face-to-face with an aura that is potent, pure and fearsome.
Stop.
The bloody tide stops in its tracks.
It was as though they ran into an invisible wall when they rounded the corner. The maggot-shaped Arts creations smash themselves into pieces, leaving bloody trails on the ground.
The empty street is completely silent.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Casualties?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: We're fine. We got out quick enough.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I hope we've delayed the Sarkaz, made things safer for Allerdale and Siege...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thanks, everyone, especially our Self-Salvation Corps friends. Thank you for being willing to take this risk with us.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Commander Clovisia calls Rhodes Island our most important ally. We're always ready to do what we have to.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Plus, if this Rhodes Island operator here hadn't helped us, that Vampire would've done all of us in a long time ago.
No need to thank me.
I've seen too much meaningless killing in Londinium. I must stop my compatriots who have gone too far.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Sorry, Doctor...

options: I thought I was just coming home with you.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I had, er, a little fight with Granny when I skipped out of the factory last year.
A dozen big, bruising workers surround you.
Their eyes are filled with suspicion.
You glance at the drills and spanners in their hands, then at Feist, dressed like the workers, but here on his own.

options: Seems like it was more than a little fight.
Are you sure they're not hostiles?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I guess Granny is still sore at me...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I've got no reason to be sore at a dead man. I didn't even know my only grandson was still alive, 'til a minute ago.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I wanted to send a message, but it was too risky. The Sarkaz monitor all communications into Highbury.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I can't let the Sarkaz tie you to the Self-Salvation Corps.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: So you joined that band of crackpots.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: ...The Londinium Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We did a lot in Sudean, Granny. The Sarkaz control the media, and they call us an 'unnamed violent gang'...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You're the ones who blew up the wall.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Er... it was the Do...

options: The Sarkaz damaged the walls while pursuing the Corps.
Your grandson fought bravely in the battle.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Right... it was mostly the Sarkaz who did it.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Thanks, Doctor.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I didn't know you had such high regard for my rope work.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: So you're here to blow up the armory?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Of course not!

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: What did you say to your Self-Salvation Corps friends? We're making weapons for the Sarkaz, to use against Victorians?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: No, Granny. What I told them was...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: My granny stands up to protect their livelihoods.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I know you think I'm a brat with little more than a couple of silly tricks.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But I didn't come back to drag the workers into this. And I'm not here to try to convince you, either.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I have my goals, of course, and it'd be brilliant if you were able to help me. But first—

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I just wanted to see that you're safe.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Come here, and let me have a look at you.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Granny...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You've put on a few inches, brat.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Yeah, I grew a little bit.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: I'll have the goods soon.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: A suit of steam armor... how many men would kill to get one like it?

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: The nobles of Leithanien love to flaunt such storied antiques.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: Oh, and do be sure to ask those Columbian firms as well. They might be interested, even if the tech is centuries old.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: Getting it out will be no trouble at all. What business do you think I'm running in Londinium these days?

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: The Sarkaz are a gang of raving psychopaths, and they alone can't rule Londinium.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: I have friends in the Defense Forces. They'll take care of it for me.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: I've heard it has a few external blemishes, however. I do hope that won't hurt the price?
Why not cancel the deal, if you're so worried about the price?

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Don't worry, we just happened to be traveling the same way.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: Get this intruder out of here!

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: Say... where are my bodyguards?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I've asked them to take a short nap. You can go and wake them once we've finished our chat.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: All of them...? Against just one of you?!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: One? Oh, my, no.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Look behind you.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: You... this is Londinium! I've got friends in high places!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Oh? Where are they? Do tell, I bet I'd get on famously.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: Eek! D-Don't do anything rash, now!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Play nice with us and nobody has to get beat.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Whatever Siege says, you do.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Otherwise, my claws won't be aimed at the wall next time.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: A-Alright! I understand!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: ...Seriously?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You really got into it there.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I learned it from you lot.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Now then, let him go.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: *whimper*...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You can open your eyes and put your hands down now, Mr. Bader. We're not going to hurt you... at least not yet.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: What do you want?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: My terms are clear. Cancel the deal for the Cumberland steam armor.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: And you'll let me go if I agree?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But I'll make sure you keep your side of the bargain.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Show Mr. Bader our map, Morgan.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: With pleasure.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: The marks on the map... those are my warehouses! How do you know about them?!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You don't pay much attention when you're out and about.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: You shadowed me?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Correct. The Sarkaz cannot be bribed. If they learn that you've smuggled so much contraband into Londinium through your 'connections'...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: How helpful do you think your friend will be? Will he be in any position to protect you?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You're considering tipping off the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: That may well get us all killed, but they won't have to know anything if you continue to work with us.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: Do I have a choice?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I understand your circumstances, and I appreciate the opportunity to work with you. You will be compensated fairly.

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: Wait a second...

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: What is your relationship to Allerdale Cumberland? Are you her attendant? I can't imagine House Cumberland is in any position to hire one...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Watch your mouth! The Cumberland serves Vina, not the other way 'round!

steps.name: Londinium Merchant
steps.text: She's the daughter of a duke! You don't mean...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: No. I'm nobody.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Lady Cumberland and I are comrades, along with thousands upon thousands of Londiniers who long for peace.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I do hope you're one of them, Mr. Bader.

steps.name: Knight
steps.text: All those loyal to this land stand with me. The final battle against evil lies before us.

steps.name: Knight
steps.text: Children... do you live here?

steps.name: Knight
steps.text: Hide not in the corners and shadows. Even if you cannot hold a sword...

steps.name: Knight
steps.text: There is more to being a warrior than simply holding a sword. Open your eyes. Watch, listen, think.

steps.name: Knight
steps.text: Tell me what is right, what is wrong, and what kind of life you wish to live.

steps.name: Knight
steps.text: I march onwards, with you as my witnesses.

steps.name: Molly
steps.text: Brilliant! Look how good Ralph is, Lady Golding... how much he's grown. And to think he was a mischievous little beastling just four years ago!

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: Yes, I'm delighted. A handkerchief, Molly?

steps.name: Molly
steps.text: Handkerchief? Oh, yes, I can't stain my clothes with tears in front of the children... Oh, but I just can't stop crying, to think that Ralph and the other kids will be leaving school so soon...

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: It's time for them to have a rest. And us, too.

steps.name: Molly
steps.text: Yes, the final scene... that's the best part.

steps.name: Molly
steps.text: Who's clapping?

steps.name: Molly
steps.text: You didn't invite anyone to the rehearsal today, did you?
The teachers cast their glances toward the back of the classroom.
A man in military attire claps slowly by the door.
What a splendid performance.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: ...Lt. Colonel Lettou.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: I didn't think the Commander of the Defense Forces would grace this classroom with his presence.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Good afternoon, ladies.
